text:
QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-576`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc`/`buffer_alloc_free`. ... With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` it installs mutex-wrapped variants (`:541-563`)."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that with MBEDTLS_THREADING_C the init installs mutex-wrapped variants. It never says a plain pair is installed otherwise, and it never says the choice is made at compile time inside the init function.
